title: Grooming package selection and home visit

turns.question: This is an enquiry only. Explain the grooming packages for my dog Bruno and how they differ.
turns.transcript: This is an inquiry only. Explain the grooming packages for my dog, Bruno, and how they differ.
turns.reply:
One moment while I check that for you. For Bruno, there are four one-time grooming options:

Essential Bath costs ₹1,349 and covers bathing, conditioning, deshedding, drying, combing and brushing. Bath & Basic costs ₹1,899 and adds nail clipping, paw massage, teeth cleaning, ear and eye cleaning, sanitary trimming, and minor face and paw trimming. Complete Makeover costs ₹2,399 and adds hair styling and full-body trimming. Just Trim costs ₹1,599 and includes a haircut, nail clipping and ear cleaning, but no bath.

Choose Essential Bath for coat maintenance, Bath & Basic for broader hygiene, Complete Makeover for a full haircut, or Just Trim if Bruno only needs trimming without a bath.

turns.question: Which grooming package includes a full haircut, and how is that different from a bath with basic grooming?
turns.transcript: Which grooming package includes a full haircut, and how is that different from a bath with basic grooming?
turns.reply: For Bruno, the Complete Makeover is the package with a full-body haircut. It includes the Bath & Basic services, plus hair styling and full-body trimming, and costs ₹2,399. Bath & Basic costs ₹1,899 and includes bathing, coat care, nails, teeth cleaning, ear and eye cleaning, sanitary trimming, and minor face and paw trimming, but not a full haircut.

turns.question: For home grooming, what should I provide and what equipment does your groomer bring?
turns.transcript: For home grooming, what should I provide, and what equipment does your groomer bring?
turns.reply: For home grooming, please provide a suitable space such as a bathroom or balcony, along with water and electricity. The groomer brings professional tools and grooming products, and cleans up afterwards. Please keep a towel handy, mention any access rules, and tell the groomer about Bruno’s fears, scratching or biting history, skin concerns, or vet restrictions. A short walk and toilet break beforehand is helpful, and avoid a heavy meal in the hour before.

turns.question: How long should I allow for grooming, and can you guarantee an exact finishing time?
turns.transcript: How long should I allow for grooming, and can you guarantee an exact finishing time?
turns.reply: Grooming time can vary with the package, Bruno’s coat, and his comfort during the appointment. I can’t guarantee an exact finishing time, so please allow some flexibility; the groomer can provide an estimate after assessing him.
